text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: —Ah, look at time.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, Hello-san.
Our outing today was wonderful.
I shall excuse myself ahead of you.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Yes, heading back to Academy. Farewell♪

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...Heard Tazuna-san had day off today though...
Could she be working?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...URA application, done.
That settles this part—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Next event's planning proposal... needs finishing
by today.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Also, need these done before start of week—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Eh?
Ah, Trainer-san, and Hello-san?!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Don't 'Hello-san' me!
Working on day off is tough enough,
aren't you taking on way too much?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Things just piled up all at once...
Handful like this is no problem at all♪

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: This isn't 'just a handful'...!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...Carrying majority of operational support
for this massive academy—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Handling irregular situations on top of that,
carrying over into holidays...
There's no way you're okay...!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...Really, it's fine...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Tazuna-san.
I'll handle vendor coordination for event.
Call in others if necessary.
choice_data_list: I can help with clerical work!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh no...!
I'm truly fine—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Focus on what only you can do, Tazuna-san!
Understood?!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Vendors likely to fit within budget,
this one, and this one...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...Um, I can manage, you know?
Little more and this task is done anyway...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Nope, leave this to us!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Regrettable! Fault lies with me for not noticing,
but you act too distant! Bottling up so much alone!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
No, please! Supporting Chairwoman
is my duty...!

text_block_list.name: Kashimoto Riko
text_block_list.text:
Pardon the intrusion, Chairwoman.
A brief word—

text_block_list.name: Kashimoto Riko
text_block_list.text:
Never thought one who constantly preaches against overwork
would overwork herself...
Here, the report.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Sorted through students' requests.
Safe to share with departments
and seek their judgment?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes...
I'm so sorry, both of you are busy as well.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, not at all! Tazuna-san helps us
all the time...
Let others support you once in a while!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
(Work getting cleared away.
With everyone lending hands...)

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
(Was I really taking on too much?
Until it overflowed again...
Thinking I could handle it alone...)

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Terrible at relying on others, aren't I.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, fufu, no.
Just old bad habit showing up again.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...Even with such reliable people right here.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Must change.
Me too. Instead of staying stuck in past ways.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Kashimoto Riko
text_block_list.text:
This part is finished.
Please check over it.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Is that everything wrapped up?
Ngh... getting so hungry~!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, everyone.
Know perfect spot for after-work meal!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Ramen shop. Place that always brings comfort
—together with everyone today!
